name: No Logo
long_description:
No Logo is building the orchestration layer for creating viral consumer products. The manufacturing world is full of capable, underutilized overseas factories with the machines, tooling, and engineers to build winning products – but no way to connect them to the creators and brands with the ideas and distribution. As a result, bringing a new product to market has traditionally taken 6-12 months, tens of thousands of dollars, and a team of 20-30 people.

No Logo collapses that. Using generative AI, we take a creator's product idea, visualize it, break it into core components and manufacturing processes, and match each step to the right factory in our network – turning an idea into a shippable product in just a few weeks.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Previously co-founded SabersPro and bootstrapped the company from 0 to $10M+ in sales in 2.5 years, where he restructured the supply chain with factories increasing margins by 15% saving ~1M in profits. Dropped out from the Business, Technology, and Entrepreneurship program (BTE) at NYU Stern.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: In high school bootstrapped a furniture startup and in under a year went from selling on Craigslist to running a 40-person factory in Shenzhen. Took those insights and dropped out of NYU Stern BTE to run No Logo, a platform that streamlines supply chain creation for growing companies.

launches.title: No Logo: Turn any idea into a real, manufactured product
launches.tagline: Building the orchestration layer for physical product creation
launches.body:
The last twenty years have made starting a business seamless. Shopify solved the store. Stripe solved payments. TikTok solved distribution. Manufacturing is the one piece that never moved. Launching a single new product still takes 6 to 12 months, tens of thousands of dollars upfront, and a team of specialists. Most great product ideas die before they become something you can hold.

We are building the orchestration layer for physical product creation, bridging the gap between customer demand and manufacturing supply.

It works like this. You describe an idea. Our AI visualizes it with you, breaks it into components and manufacturing processes, and matches each step to the right factory in our network. We run production, QC, and fulfillment, going from idea to a growing brand in about a month with no upfront costs.

We are not putting logos on mugs. We create entirely new consumer products: a digital camera that clips onto a purse, a lava-lamp humidifier, a painting that glows like the sun. We are starting with creators whose audiences have already validated demand; production happens only after demand exists, not before.

So far we’ve launched hundreds of products, shipped tens of thousands of items, and reached creator audiences totaling more than 90M people. Every product we create makes the network faster and smarter for the next one.

Have a product idea your audience keeps asking for? We'll make it real. [nologo.com](http://nologo.com)

launches.title: Terra 🌎: Instant supply chain creation
launches.tagline: Enter Terra, a new world of procurement.
launches.body:
# **TL;DR -**

Use [Terra](http://useterra.com) as an all-in-one platform to seamlessly **develop, manufacture, and ship your products**. Discover pre-vetted suppliers and instantly create modular supply chains, all while having access to wholesale pricing regardless of order quantity.

—

# **The Team**

Hello all! We’re [Dylan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dylan-mcfarland/) and [Lev](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lev-glushkovskii/) from Terra, and we’re _really_ passionate about making custom manufacturing accessible to everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83615&key=user_uploads/1859401/1b3de9c2-aefa-40aa-aeeb-7243b3bec363)

# **🚨 The Problem 🚨**

We’ve been working with suppliers globally since we were freshmen in high school. If you can think of a costly manufacturing or shipping mistake, we’ve likely already made it a dozen times over. But through our experiences building supply chains, we’ve routinely run into the same issues: 

⚙️ Way too many moving parts 

⚠️ The best factories have high minimum order requirements 

👎 Current software is either too rudimentary or ridiculously complex

# **✅ The Solution ✅**

* Forget spending weeks juggling multiple supplier group chats, spreadsheets of shipping quotes, and financial docs. Terra automatically matches you with the right partners through a single dashboard, allowing you to launch products in minutes.
* We aggregate demand based on similarity, ensuring you’ll get access to the best pricing and factories regardless of order size.
*  Our platform is completely modular. Build a supply chain entirely from our pre-vetted partners, onboard your existing suppliers, or use a combination of both. No constrictions, only flexibility.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83615&key=user_uploads/1859401/38054f53-5593-4f5e-8f1e-0e80ff948676)

# **🤝 Our Ask 🤝**

Are you or anyone in your network looking to launch/scale/streamline manufacturing processes? If so, hit us at [founders@useterra.com](mailto:founders@useterra.com), we’d love to get in touch.

Currently looking specifically for anyone selling/manufacturing furniture or home goods!
